articles.headline: Records reveal other women told police of incidents with Packers' Josh Jacobs
articles.description: Multiple women contacted police to detail allegations against Packers running back Josh Jacobs following his May arrest for an altercation with his then-girlfriend.
articles.body:
As police investigated whether to file charges against Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs following a May altercation with his then-girlfriend, multiple other women contacted them to detail their own allegations against him.

Those accounts were included in evidence regarding Jacobs' battery case that the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department released Friday night in response to a public records request. Green Bay TV station NBC 26 first reported the records release.

Jacobs pleaded no contest Sept. 10 to misdemeanor counts of battery and criminal damage to property. He was arrested May 26, three days after an incident in which a woman said he threw her to the ground.

According to the records that were released Friday night, one woman contacted police after Jacobs' arrest to say she had experience a similar incident with him around 2023. She later would say the incident actually occurred on Jan. 5, 2022.

The woman said she had communicated with Jacobs for about six months before spending about 11 hours at his home. The woman said that after she told Jacobs she hadn't come there for sex, he became angry, slapped her across the face and told her not to disrespect him.

She said he took her phone and threw it into a swimming pool when she attempted to leave, and that he grabbed her by the hair, threw her onto a bed, pinned her down, threw her to the floor and said that "I should kill you right now." She said Jacobs also spit on her.

The woman said that she hadn't previously reported the incident to law enforcement because she remained friends with Jacobs afterward and was concerned her allegations wouldn't be believed. The woman said she contacted police this time because she believed it showed a pattern of behavior similar to the allegations in the May case.

Another woman told police she had sex with Jacobs in April 2021. The woman said that his condom broke, so she told Jacobs to get tested for sexually transmitted diseases because they both had been involved with other people.

The woman said Jacobs later removed her from the residence, grabbed her by the arms and bicep area, pushed her against a wall and threw her belongings out. She told police that she suffered bruises to her arms and swelling in her rib area.

Hobart/Lawrence police said they obtained records from that incident indicating officers observed "no visible signs of injury, bruising or damage consistent with a physical altercation."

Another woman said she met Jacobs through social media and that he flew her to a residence in May 2022. She described an altercation in which Jacobs grabbed her by the hair, placed his hands on her head and neck, dragged her, scratched her chest and took her phone after it fell to the floor.

The woman said she got bruises on her arm and scratches to her chest and neck. She said she didn't report the incident to police because she wasn't a U.S. citizen at the time and that Jacobs told her she could be deported.

articles.headline: Dillon Brooks ejected from Suns' loss after flagrant foul 2 in third quarter
articles.description: Phoenix Suns forward Dillon Brooks was ejected Friday night in a 127-120 loss to the Denver Nuggets for kicking guard Jamal Murray in the groin, an infraction that officials upgraded to a Flagrant 2 foul, which is an automatic ejection.
articles.body:
PHOENIX -- Phoenix Suns forward Dillon Brooks was ejected Friday night in a 127-120 loss to the Denver Nuggets for kicking Jamal Murray in the groin.

Brooks attempted a turnaround jumper in the third quarter with Murray guarding, and when Brooks fell backward, he kicked his right leg forward, making contact with Murray.

Brooks was called for an offensive foul, and Murray was writhing in pain on the court for a few moments before eventually getting up and staying in the game. The officials reviewed the play and upgraded the foul to a flagrant 2, which is an automatic ejection.

Murray, who finished with 39 points, said postgame that he didn't believe the kick was intentional and that he and Brooks are "buddies." They are teammates on the Canadian national team.

"No, of course not," Murray said. "He's shooting the ball. I mean, he might have flopped a little bit, but I don't think he's really trying to kick me in the [groin]."

Brooks was leading the Suns with 22 points on 9-of-12 shooting at the time of his ejection.

articles.headline: Stephen Curry scores 31 points and outduels Luka Doncic as Warriors come back to beat Lakers 112-95
articles.description: — Stephen Curry had 31 points, six assists and four rebounds, and the Golden State Warriors erased an early 25-point deficit then ran away from Luka Doncic and the Los Angeles Lakers for a 112-95 win Friday night in an NBA Cup game.
articles.body:
SAN FRANCISCO -- — Stephen Curry had 31 points, six assists and four rebounds, and the Golden State Warriors erased an early 25-point deficit then ran away from Luka Doncic and the Los Angeles Lakers for a 112-95 win Friday night in an NBA Cup game.


              Doncic had 37 points, seven rebounds and five assists, but the Lakers couldn't make it back-to-back blowouts against Golden State after winning the teams' season opener last week in LA. 


              It was the largest margin of victory in the shot clock era for a team that trailed by 20 or more points at end of the first quarter. On March 4, 1976, the Warriors trailed the Bulls 41-18 after one quarter and won by 14 at 124-110 — the previous best.


              In the fourth, Curry passed Dominique Wilkins (26,668) for 18th place on the NBA's all-time scoring list.


              Brandin Podziemski added 21 points, six assists and five rebounds, while De'Anthony Melton scored 16 off the bench and fellow reserve Georges Niang 11 for the Warriors.


              Doncic had 21 points on 7 for 12 shooting with five 3-pointers, five assists and a pair of steals through the first quarter as the Lakers raced ahead 38-15.


              The Warriors then outscored the Lakers by the same 38-15 score in the second. That made Golden State the first team in the shot clock era — including playoffs — to trail by 23 or more points at the end of the first quarter and be tied or better at halftime.


              Curry hit a 3 over Doncic at the 6:22 mark of the third quarter only for the Lakers star to knock one down from deep moments later on the other end. Doncic was whistled for a technical with 21.8 seconds left in the third, with fans chanting and booing at him, then teammate Matisse Thybulle received a technical in the fourth.


              The Lakers capitalized on 17 Golden State turnovers for 25 points, 10 of those miscues in the opening period.


              Up next
              Lakers: Host Raptors on Sunday night.


              Warriors: Host Clippers on Sunday night.

articles.headline: Michael Carrick: 'Hard truths' have been shared amid Man United slump
articles.description: Manchester United manager Michael Carrick said "hard truths" have been spoken between himself, the players and the club hierarchy amid an eight-game winless run.
articles.headlineJa: マイケル・キャリック：「マンUの低迷の中、『厳しい真実』が語られた」
articles.descriptionJa: マンチェスター・ユナイテッドのマイケル・キャリック監督は、8試合未勝利が続く中で、自身と選手、そしてクラブ幹部の間で「厳しい真実」が共有されたと語った。
articles.body:
Manchester United manager Michael Carrick has said "hard truths" have been spoken between himself, the players and the club hierarchy during an eight-game winless run that has left him fighting for his job at Old Trafford.

United face Chelsea at Stamford Bridge on Saturday aiming to win a domestic fixture for the first time since a 5-2 Premier League victory against Ipswich on Aug. 30 -- United's only league win so far this season.

- Tielemans backs Carrick to stay in Man United job

- Global power ranking: The top 20 soccer teams in the world, ranked!

- Carrick: 'Fully committed' Fernandes retains Man United captaincy

Last Sunday's 3-0 home defeat against Bournemouth, four days after a humiliating 4-1 Champions League loss away to Italian debutants Como, raised serious doubts over Carrick's United future before the 45-year-old was told by senior figures that he would remain in charge with pressure mounting to halt the dismal run of form.

But with criticism directed at his players and also CEO Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox following their failure to sufficiently bolster the United squad this summer, Carrick said blunt conversations have taken place between parties in an effort to resolve the team's problems.

"It's pretty clear," Carrick told reporters. "It's not always rosy and nice conversations between anyone, whether that's between me and the players or whether it's between me, Jason, Omar or the owners.

"It's the truth, it's the hard truth at times and it's what we need to move forward. Whatever we need to move forward, we'll do.

"We always do what we think is going to get the best out of the team. Whether that's certain players that, of course, you speak to at certain points, that's normal.

"That's why, if you ask for leaders in the dressing room, you want opinions on certain things and there's going to be times when you ask that, that's fine.

"Absolutely no problem. It doesn't mean that we always agree with that, but absolutely no problem with that. And then we head off in the same direction."

United are in their worst run of form since the 1988-89 season and have made their worst start to a league campaign since 1986-87, when manager Ron Atkinson was fired and replaced by Alex Ferguson.

But Carrick said that much of the team's issues are rooted in a loss of confidence -- something he says can be rectified.

"Confidence is the beauty of sport," he said. "Confidence is in some ways the major factor of that belief, that self-belief, that confidence level.

"It kind of trumps everything else in terms of level of performance. But the beauty about confidence, it can come back quickly in one moment, one thing in a game, one win, one result.

"We've seen it before, we've seen it a few months ago, it can come back quickly. And that's what keeps you pushing and keeps you believing that it's always that close and what's possible is always within touching distance.

articles.headline: Achraf Hakimi scores 1st career hat trick as Luis Enrique makes PSG history
articles.description: Right back Achraf Hakimi claimed a first career hat trick and provided two assists as Luis Enrique became the winningest coach in Paris Saint-Germain history on Friday.
articles.headlineJa: アシュラフ・ハキミがキャリア初のハットトリック、ルイス・エンリケがPSGの歴史を塗り替える
articles.descriptionJa: 金曜日、右サイドバックのアシュラフ・ハキミがキャリア初のハットトリックを達成し、2アシストを記録。ルイス・エンリケはパリ・サンジェルマン史上最多勝利を記録する監督となった。
articles.body:
Right back Achraf Hakimi claimed a first career hat trick and provided two assists as Luis Enrique became the winningest coach in Paris Saint-Germain history on Friday.

The Ligue 1 leaders came from behind to thrash bottom club Le Havre 5-1 with Morocco international Hakimi playing a role in all five goals.

- PSG's Luis Enrique: Vitinha's Ballon d'Or ranking too low

- PSG star Kvaratskhelia undergoes successful knee surgery

He is just the fourth player with five goal contributions in a single game in the last four seasons in the top five European leagues. The last player to achieve that feat in France's Ligue 1 was Neymar for PSG in August 2022.

The result took Luis Enrique to 127 wins, breaking a tie with Laurent Blanc for most in PSG's history.

The reigning French and European champions briefly looked in danger of suffering a major shock when former Sunderland and West Brom forward Josh Maja gave the winless hosts an 18th-minute lead.

But captain Hakimi set up Mika Godts to level before completing the turnaround with a smart finish two minutes later and then curling home a fine 20-yard free kick early in the second half.

Hakimi, who had not scored this season ahead of kickoff, completed his landmark treble in fortuitous fashion in the 69th minute, after his through ball allowed Senny Mayulu to register the visitors' fourth goal.

The 27-year-old's first hat trick for club and country came in the 486th game of his career.

PSG's victory was their ninth in a row in all competitions -- and sixth successive league win -- after they picked up just a point from their opening three fixtures.

In the continued absence of key attackers Ousmane Dembélé and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia through injury, Luis Enrique made five changes to his starting XI following Monday's 2-0 success over Lyon.

Information from ESPN Research and PA contributed to this report.

articles.headline: Bayern Munich not allowing Kompany to be involved in Dortmund clash
articles.description: Vincent Kompany won't be on the sidelines for Bayern's match against Borussia Dortmund following his hospitalization last week.
articles.body:
MUNICH -- Bayern Munich are not allowing coach Vincent Kompany to be part of their plans for Saturday's Klassiker against Bundesliga rival Borussia Dortmund following his collapse and hospitalization last week.

Assistant coach Aaron Danks said on Friday there were orders not to discuss the game with Kompany, even though he's out of hospital and recovering at home.

"We don't talk to him about football. We've been given clear instructions there," Danks said. "He needs to recover and spend time with his family. We're not getting him involved so he can be fully back at it when he returns."

Danks oversaw a 6-1 win over Magdeburg in the German Cup on Wednesday. Saturday's game against Dortmund is likely to see Harry Kane return to action after winning the Ballon d'Or on Monday.

Danks said not much has changed in how Bayern are training for the game, adding that Kompany's assistants aren't "mini-Vinnies" but have skill sets which complement each other to work together in his absence.

Bayern board member for sport Max Eberl told German broadcaster ARD on Wednesday that Kompany was treated for meningeal irritation, which is an inflammation of the tissue around the brain or spinal cord.

Before his collapse, Kompany had also been struggling with a viral infection and a hip injury.

articles.headline: USMNT star Christian Pulisic signs new AC Milan contract through 2031
articles.description: United States star Christian Pulisic has signed a new contract with AC Milan through 2031.
articles.body:
United States star Christian Pulisic has signed a new contract with AC Milan through 2031.

The deal for Pulisic, 28, was reported by ESPN on Wednesday and confirmed on Friday, a day after AC Milan announced plans for their new stadium.

"Captain America's Rossonero mission continues," wrote AC Milan on Friday.

Pulisic's deal was due to expire in June 2027, but he has committed his future to the Rossoneri on a contract that will take him beyond the next World Cup.

"There's a lot of emotions, I'm really proud to re-sign here in Milan because I'm really just in love with this team, this club, everything about it," Pulisic said in an interview on the club's social media pages. "The feeling that I got, the support from the fans through all of the good and bad times, I knew immediately that this was the place for me.:

He joined AC Milan in 2023 from Chelsea for a fee in the region of €22 million ($24.4m). At the Serie A club, Pulisic has 44 goals and 28 assists across his 141 appearances and was the club's top scorer in the 2024-25 season.

"Milan has given me everything, it feels like home for me," he said. "It's where I want to spend my next years because I'm just really happy here, I love it here, my family loves it here. I want to continue to give everything and bring this club to the top.

He added: "I look at my whole life as a book, to be honest, and i feel like this is the most important chapter right now."

Pulisic signed for Borussia Dortmund back in 2015 and established himself as one of the best young players in the Bundesliga. Chelsea signed him for £58m ($71.7m) in 2018, and he won the 2021 Champions League there.

But injury disrupted his progress at Chelsea, and in 2023, AC Milan saw off competition from Juventus, Lyon and Galatasaray to sign him.

- Pulisic staying in Milan reflects his club career: Good, but not quite great

- Cavan Sullivan turned 17 last month, but he's already playing like an MLS MVP

- Ex-USMNT star Eddie Johnson to train 3-year-old removed from Florida soccer game

Pulisic missed most of AC Milan's preseason due to the injury he sustained during the World Cup. But after a steady reintegration into the first team under Ruben Amorim, he has become an integral part of the manager's Milan blueprint, playing in the No. 10 role and on the wing.

Pulisic's new deal follows the unveiling of AC Milan's new stadium, which will be ready in 2031. The clubs said in a news release Thursday that the deal represented "one of the largest stadium naming rights agreements in global sport."

At the international level, Pulisic has established himself as a key player for the USMNT with 33 goals in 90 appearances. He played in the 2022 and 2026 World Cups for the USMNT and won U.S. Soccer Male Player of the Year in 2017, 2019, 2021 and 2023.
